fixed: The flight up to the journal showed bare sky for two and a half seconds; the page now waits there as a pale outline of what is coming and flies in on 'journal', framed below the title.
The title 29 MINUTES / WITH HELP covered the record's clock; the clock hangs lower on the lobby wall and counts up to 29:03 under it.
Your heart slowing down was said over a closed body; the chest opens on it and the heart glows as it beats slowly.
notes: Up from the houseboats to the journal page in the sky (CELL 2018); into its figure, the gene glowing (PDE10A), a hormone drifting to the spleen with a question mark (NOBODY KNOWS YET); through the water to the record's pool, its clock running up to 29:03 (29 MINUTES / WITH HELP), close on the oxygen tank (PURE OXYGEN); through the water home to the bath, your chest opening on a slow glowing heart, the spleen squeezing, and up out of the bath as the counter stops (IT'S ALREADY HAPPENING). Measured: never empty for more than 0.4 s, never still for more than 2 s.
